continuity.arc_goal: Add complete linked workflow support to the Rust SDK with proper type separation between VO and workflow contexts, full protocol integration, and compile-time validation

progress_update.summary: We completed the final API refinements: Cancellation type narrows Invocation for VO contexts, start_linked() downgraded from DurableFuture to impl Future (quick protocol op), Invocation::result() remains DurableFuture for selectable child completion. Ran final comprehensive code review — no critical issues, all findings addressed. Removed InvocationIdBackedInvocationHandle (unified into Invocation), Invocation no longer implements InvocationHandle (clean resolved/unresolved separation). Three code reviews total this session, all findings resolved.
progress_update.goal: Complete linked workflow SDK with proper type separation between VO and workflow contexts, ready for PR
accomplished: Added Cancellation type wrapping Invocation — narrows API to id() + cancel() for VO path
link() generic over T: From<Invocation> — VO returns Cancellation, workflow returns Invocation
Downgraded start_linked() from DurableFuture to impl Future — quick op doesn't need select!
Invocation::result::<T>() remains DurableFuture — selectable for long-running child completion
Invocation no longer implements InvocationHandle — clean separation
Renamed invocation_handle() → invocation(), returns Invocation directly
Added resolve(&self) to InvocationHandle — resolves any handle to Invocation
Exported Invocation and Cancellation in prelude
Fixed duplicate doc comment on Cancellation
Three code reviews — all findings addressed
progress_update.now: Session complete. All review findings addressed. Feature ready for PR preparation.
next_steps: Squash commit history before PR — many iterative commits across 6 sessions
Switch shared-core from path dep back to published version
Integration testing with Restate container when available
Consider whether InvocationHandle still needs invocation_id() given resolve() exists
constraints: No mock VM in codebase — integration tests require real Restate container
decisions: start_linked() returns impl Future (not DurableFuture) — link establishment is fast
result() returns impl DurableFuture — child completion can be long, needs select! support
Cancellation wraps Invocation via From — compile-time API narrowing for VO contexts
link() generic over T: From<Invocation> — type inference at call site
Invocation does NOT implement InvocationHandle — resolved vs unresolved separation
on_completion only via ObjectContextT path — no runtime panic risk
Handler input type: Result<T, TerminalError> where T: serde::Deserialize
T-suffix naming: ObjectContextT, RunRequestT, WorkflowClientT, RunT, CompletionHandlerFnT
sys_link returns LinkHandle (not SendHandle) with link_completion_handle
API: run_linked(req) on workflow client returns Request with linked:bool=true, .send() emits both OneWayCallCommand + CreateLinkCommand
API: unlink() on workflow client, fire-and-forget, emits RemoveLinkCommand
API: .send() returns impl InvocationHandle regardless of linked flag — CreateLink completion handled internally
open_questions: Should InvocationHandle::invocation_id() be removed since resolve() exists?
